differences: Different operation combinations and quantified equations.
Each contributes a different part of the chosen axiom basis.

mapping.assumptions: Total operations, potentially noncommutative sequencing, and no inferred concurrency or reordering guarantee.
mapping.carriers: The same total program-effect carrier E in the chosen effect-quantale profile.
mapping.equality: Carrier equality on effects, with the stated order/join conventions.
mapping.operations: Distributivity uses both sequencing and join; the monoid condition uses sequencing and epsilon.

result.rationale: Distributivity links sequencing to join, whereas the monoid rules give sequencing associativity and the no-effect identity. These are complementary interface obligations, not duplicate statements.
